head: Natural Cycles ring launches in the UK, included with the annual plan
dek: Natural Cycles has started selling the NC Ring in the UK, a smart ring that measures body temperature overnight for its contraception app. New annual subscribers at 89.99 pounds get the ring at no extra cost until 31 December.
details: The ring weighs from 1.9 grams depending on size, is 5.8 mm wide, can go under water and lasts up to 14 days per charge on a magnetic wireless charger. The app combines the overnight temperature with cycle data to show a daily fertility status; Natural Cycles says the method is 93% effective with typical use. The app is registered with the UK's medicines regulator, the MHRA. Orders and shipping started on 17 November; a price for the ring alone and plans for other countries weren't given.
where: UK, on sale and shipping from 17 November
means: If you use Natural Cycles in the UK, or are thinking about it, the annual plan now comes with its own temperature ring instead of a thermometer or another brand's ring.
todo: If you want the ring included, sign up for the annual plan before 31 December. Already a subscriber? Check the Natural Cycles app or website for what applies to you, as the offer is for new customers.
thumb_words: NATURAL CYCLES LAUNCHES ITS OWN RING
